svg.aria-label: How the 30 playlist songs are chosen. Four slots: 15 confident, 6 deep cuts, 6 explore, 3 wildcard. The right side shows which part of the ranked candidate list each slot draws from.
svg.title: How the 30 playlist songs are chosen
svg.desc: Four slots: 15 confident, 6 deep cuts, 6 explore, 3 wildcard. The right side shows which part of the ranked candidate list each slot draws from.
svg.text: How the 30 playlist songs are chosen
Four slots with different jobs. The final order is shuffled.
The same 30, shuffled into play order
Shuffling means position says nothing about how a song was chosen.
New-artist candidates, best score on the left
The top 15 by score, always included.
6 drawn at random from the best 18 songs by artists you already like.
6 drawn from the next 18 new songs. Higher scores are more likely.
3 drawn evenly from everything left. Tests what the scores miss.
